edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: Subclinical disease likely matters through milder versions of the same lipid and vascular pathways, though the signal is weaker and more threshold dependent.
edges.summary: What makes this pair believable is not one flashy paper but the way the literature stacks up: the 2025 Hysaj meta analysis in Eur J Endocrinol already points to subclinical hypothyroidism tracks with higher risk or worse outcomes, and later studies mostly refine the size of the effect rather than overturning it. In practice this reads more like a real risk signal than a one-off finding.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
